meta.title: MERIDIAN
meta.subtitle: field manual · vol. i
meta.target: 10-14 LPA · product co / funded startup / GCC · Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, NCR or remote
meta.note: Every resource here is free. No paid course is required to complete this track.

principles: Evals are the differentiator. 'Accuracy went 61% -> 84% after reranking' beats every certificate.
When an AI feature feels dumb it is almost always the retriever, not the model.
Ship one AI feature at your current job. 'Production' on a resume outranks 'personal project'.
Two deep projects, not eight shallow ones.
Build it by hand before you reach for the framework. Then reach for the framework.
Apply from Month 4, not Month 7. Interviews are the fastest feedback loop you have.
